_comment: FR-EQ-017 理想外扭曲模的 q 极限 —— 2026-09-18 实测。门：$FYLITE_KERNEL/rust/fylite/src/stability.rs::tests

model.equation: Newcomb, reduced MHD, cylindrical screw pinch, m/n external kink, ideal wall at r = b
model.form: Riccati on u = r psi1'/psi1 :  u' = (m^2 - u^2)/r + r V(r),  u(0+) = m
model.V: q m / (r (m - n q)) * d/dr[ 2/q - r q'/q^2 ]
model.edge_jump: Delta u = -(2 - a q'/q) * m/(m - n q_a)
model.matching: W(q_a) = u(a) + Delta u + m (1+lambda)/(1-lambda);  W = 0 是 marginal，W < 0 不稳

closed_form_band_edges._comment: ★推导自洽性的检验：均匀电流下 V=0 故 u(a)=m、q'=0 故 Delta u=-2m/(m-n q_a)，代入解出 m-n q_a = 1-lambda

wall_sweep._comment: 宽度逐个对闭式 (1-lambda)/n，相对差 < 1e-10

peaking_sweep._comment: q(r) = q_a (1 + nu r^2/a^2)/(1+nu)：nu = 0 即均匀电流

refusal.no_resonance: 整条剖面在共振之下时**不**拒绝 —— 拒绝是精确的，不是见 q 变化就拒

grid_independence._comment: ★判据 1e-9。域页要求「收敛档要记明」，所以不够的那一档也记下来

uniform_nu0.note: V ≡ 0，RK4 无事可做，三档都在机器精度上；那个「阶」是噪声

order_history._comment: ★阶数由最弱的一环定，这一条走了三步才到位
order_history.step2_note: ★内点升四阶而端点留二阶，结果**比全用二阶更差** —— 边缘跃变项直接用 q'(a)
order_history.step4_note: ★RK4 半步的 V 取两端平均是二阶的，它把四阶方法压回二阶 —— 藏在「取个平均」里
